title: Convergence Report
description: Summary report from the convergence-reporter agent after an autonomous run.

iteration.description: Current iteration number in the autonomous run

composite_score.description: Weighted composite quality score across all domains (0=worst, 1=perfect)

trajectory.description: Score history across iterations, used to detect convergence or stalls

iteration.description: Iteration number for this data point

delta.description: Change in score from the previous iteration (positive=improvement)

recommendation.description: Human-readable recommendation for next steps based on trajectory analysis
